proposal: FND-06 immutable private quarantine/scanner foundation v1
status: Isolated synthetic foundation only. Real storage/scanner, OS ACLs, encryption/custody, durable scan-head/promotion and authorized ordinary delivery remain unaccepted.
basis: Final SRS v1.1 FR-DOC-003/005/034/035, BR-042, NFR-SEC-005

ports.runtime: Bind unavailable ports only. No default positive disk/scanner/gate/policy/clock.

original_reference: versioned canonical fingerprint; callers never select filesystem path, object key or original filename

lab_storage.isolation: Testing guard, explicit install, no configured local-disk/public-root/link overlap; validate current roots/ancestors/files each operation with Windows-aware segment matching. No Laravel Storage fallback, URL/public read/delete/release methods.
lab_storage.immutability: Exclusive-create bounded record binds full original metadata fingerprint and bytes. Identical replay succeeds. Conflicting owner/version/type/digest/body or incomplete record fences, never overwrites/repairs/deletes.
lab_storage.limit: 64KiB synthetic cap only. FR-DOC-005 proposed initial limits are 5MB JPG/JPEG/PNG portrait,10MB JPG/JPEG/PNG document scan,20MB PDF, subject to university-approved actual type/structure/size policy. This lab cap does not adopt or activate production limits.
lab_storage.limitations: PHP path checks and mode bits do not certify Windows ACLs, encryption, hostile same-OS-user races or web-server configuration; no real files or students permitted. Retain all partial/unknown-effect evidence.

scan_orchestration: Only server-resolved metadata/current permission gate and current explicit policy/clock. Denied permission or scanner outage prevents scanner byte handoff.
Read immutable snapshot; independently compare exact size/SHA before scanner. Recheck permission, policy fingerprint, scanner availability and budget after both I/O phases.

Fresh service-owned scan UUID must be echoed exactly; object/policy fingerprints, scanner and malware-definition version, time window and actual media/type/structure/malware/active-content checks must match. No cached clean fallback.
Budget uses trusted wall observations plus monotonic elapsed time. Synchronous late-result rejection cannot cancel a hung scanner; real transport deadline/cancellation remains pending.

Clean/unsafe output is bounded scan metadata only. No ordinary bytes, permission, persisted security-cleared state or academic authenticity decision. Error/unavailable/uncertainty remain quarantined with redacted exceptions.
signatureVersion is the malware-definition version, not cryptographic authentication. A future real adapter must have independently reviewed trust, pins, freshness and rollback behavior.
durable_followup: Persist exact original scan command/IDs and current version/object binding before external scan I/O; atomic append-only scan history plus scan-head/state/audit/outbox reconciliation in a separately reviewed isolated schema.

Conditional promotion requires current latest scan, policy/definition state, original checksum, object/version ownership, current authorization and recovery consistency; older clean cannot overwrite newer unsafe/error/revocation.

Files remain private after security clearance. Ordinary authenticated delivery must recheck current role/record permission, quarantine/scan and policy state; no existing generic signed-storage URL is a delivery authorization.

Preserve originals; optimized previews are separate immutable objects. No quality/authenticity/academic acceptance from scanner clean. Unsafe replacement/isolation/notification/retention/disposal require approved procedures.
activation_acceptance: Approved actual file-type/structure/size rules and limits, private storage region/provider/budget, least privilege/encryption/key custody, quarantine ACLs and scanner/definition ownership.
Two-instance outage/retry/lost-ACK/restore/key-or-definition rollover acceptance and current revocation evidence; local Mongo/filesystem consistency is not independent recovery truth.

All required M0 session/security/governance gates, approved metadata transitions, durable scan history/outbox and authorized delivery/negative tests before any business upload/preview/download endpoint.
rollback: Selective reviewed source restoration only; retain bytes/partial records/audit/receipts/evidence. No automatic cleanup, TTL, destructive Mongo operation or accepted schema/config change.
